piece_type: HCP branded website “SKYRIZI VS STELARA (ustekinumab)” webpage (US-SKZG-241257)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “SKYRIZI vs STELARA® (ustekinumab)[;] SKYRIZI ACHIEVED SUPERIORITY ACROSS SEVERAL RANKED ENDPOINTS IN A HEAD-TO-HEAD STUDY” | “FIRST APPROVED CROHN’S DISEASE THERAPY THAT MET ENDOSCOPIC SUPERIORITY ENDPOINTS IN A HEAD-TO-HEAD TRIAL” | “~2X MORE PATIENTS ON SKYRIZI DEMONSTRATED ENDOSCOPIC REMISSION VS STELARA AT WEEK 48” | “SUPERIORITY MET ACROSS ENDOSCOPIC OUTCOMES” | “~2X MORE PATIENTS ON SKYRIZI WERE IN ENDOSCOPIC REMISSION WITHOUT STEROIDS (STEROID-FREE ENDOSCOPIC REMISSION) VS STELARA AT WEEK 48”
cases.context: Phase 3b SEQUENCE open-label head-to-head; completion 90.2% vs 72.8%; missing week-48 endoscopy 16% vs 34%; unblinded endoscopist. Disclaimer: “DATA LIMITATION: The open-label nature of this study may have influenced these results”.
cases.rationale: Open-label design with differential dropout/missingness cannot support conclusory superiority; disclaimer does not cure.
cases.check: Judge: head-to-head superiority claims — check blinding, differential dropout/missing data; open-label comparator studies need strong caution; disclaimer is not a fix.
